field-fold.name: Field Fold
field-fold.offer: A printed-map kit for urban sketchers
field-fold.audience: Urban sketchers arriving from a sketch-club email who already understand sketch walks and are deciding whether this kit fits their next outing.
field-fold.problem: They need to understand the kit contents, choose an available edition and see the complete reservation cost before sharing an email address.
objections: Is the edition I want available?
What is the total and what happens after I reserve?
field-fold.traffic: A high-intent sketch-club email describing a printed-map kit; no unprovided ad promise.
field-fold.voice: Precise, inviting and observant; concrete product language.
field-fold.conversion: A successful local simulated reservation after edition, quantity and email have been validated; no real order, payment or email.
contents: Two original A3 foldout schematic prints
field-fold.delivery: USD 5 shipping per order. No delivery date is supplied or promised.
field-fold.returns: Unused kits may be returned within 14 days; the buyer pays return postage.
field-fold.assetFacts: The original kit/map illustrations are schematic, not photographs, real navigation maps, print-quality evidence or previews of unprovided edition differences. Edition-specific design, color and route differences are not supplied; all editions share the listed contents and price.

assets.caption: Original schematic map illustration for this fictional kit; not a real navigation map or photograph.
Original schematic kit-contents illustration. All editions share the listed contents; this is not a photograph or evidence of print finish.

field-fold.proof: Only the supplied schematic contents/artifacts and explicit fixture facts are available. No customer logos, testimonials, measured outcomes or manufacturing claims are supplied.
field-fold.behavior: The primary CTA reaches a local form. Choose an edition, whole quantity 1–3 within stock, and a required valid email. Display item subtotal, USD 5 shipping and total with the reservation decision. Night cannot be reserved; Ridge quantity 3 is invalid. First valid submission fails recoverably; retry retains all values and succeeds with exact edition, quantity and total. No order, payment or email is sent. No backend, external form request or reload persistence.
field-fold.privacy: Demo privacy: entered values stay in current-page memory. This prototype does not transmit the reservation, process payment or send email. No reload persistence, analytics or cookies are required.
field-fold.terms: Demo terms: fictional product, stock and policies; local simulation only. No real reservation, order or payment is created. Do not invent additional guarantees, sustainability/material/production claims or real navigation accuracy.

relay-notes.name: Relay Notes
relay-notes.offer: A release-email drafting workspace for small open-source maintainers
relay-notes.audience: Maintainers of small open-source projects arriving from an article or email and comparing whether the drafting workflow fits their team.
relay-notes.problem: They have Markdown change notes but need to understand the preparation workflow, collaboration limit and billing choice before starting a demo workspace.
objections: Does this work with my existing Markdown notes?
What is included for my team and chosen billing period?
Does the demo connect to Git, send email or start billing?
relay-notes.traffic: An organic article or email about preparing release-email drafts, with no unprovided performance promise.
relay-notes.voice: Clear, practical and calm; concrete workflow and cost language.
relay-notes.conversion: A successful local simulated workspace setup after workspace name, email and billing choice validation; no real account, payment, trial activation or email.
relay-notes.integrationLimits: No live Git integration or actual sending is implemented or promised in this slice. No AI quality, time-saving, security or privacy outcome guarantee is supplied.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.condition: USD 12 per workspace each month, with up to 3 editors.

plans.name: Annual
plans.period: per workspace per year, billed once yearly

relay-notes.trial: The fictional offer includes a 14-day trial. The demo asks for no card and does not start a real trial, account or billing agreement.
relay-notes.billingLimits: No real subscription, payment or cancellation is processed. No real cancellation/refund policy beyond this demo is supplied; do not invent one or imply cancel-anytime terms.
